name: Binh Thuy communal house
kicker: Communal house, also called Long Tuyền Cổ Miếu
summary: Communal hall in Bình Thủy honoring early settlers: a short stop by the ancient house, best on festival day. It is also called Long Tuyền Cổ Miếu, and the yearly Kỳ Yên Thượng Điền festival is held here. Go if you are already at the Dương house, since a quiet day makes a brief visit.
getThere: By taxi or motorbike, with the ancient house
heroCaption: The yellow hall and stele at Đình Bình Thủy
body: The hall is also known as Long Tuyền Cổ Miếu. Each year it holds the Kỳ Yên Thượng Điền festival, which honors the early settlers and local heroes of the area.
It stands in the same district as the Dương family's ancient house, so the two fit in one trip. Each has its own gate. The festival follows the lunar calendar, so its civil date moves each year.

figures.caption: Interior of Đình Bình Thủy
figures.alt: Interior of the Binh Thuy communal house in Can Tho

gettingThere: The hall is in Bình Thủy, the same district as the ancient house at 144 Bùi Hữu Nghĩa. Go by taxi or motorbike from Ninh Kiều.

legs.heading: From the ancient house
legs.body: In the same district of Bình Thủy.
